review:
The Catfather is a 2016 Pragmatic Play slot with a 3x5 layout and nine lines that pay both left to right and right to left. A gang of cats are the symbols, and the double-direction lines increase how often wins land.

The Wild Night feature can randomly add fully expanded wilds across any combination of reels 1, 2 and 3. In free spins, every win is multiplied by 4x. The standout statistic is the published RTP of 98.1%, unusually high for any slot. Pragmatic Play doesn't list a max win. It's an older game, but that RTP makes it a notable pick for long, low-stakes demo sessions.
pros: Excellent 98.10% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
